## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in YouTube Marketing, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. What is a thumbnail's job on YouTube?
+ To earn the click from someone scanning a page full of options
- To summarise the whole video
- To carry as much text as will fit
= The thumbnail and title compete for attention against every other result on the screen.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.

Marked out of 100. The bands below are placeholders until the assignment is written.
